en.hubeali:
Al Husayn Bin Muhammad, from Moalla Bin Muhammad, from Al Washa, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Al-Hassan<sup>asws</sup>, said,

‘I heard him<sup>asws</sup> saying: ‘Allah<sup>azwj</sup> Mighty and Majestic Hates ‘الْقِيلَ وَ الْقَالَ’ (the ‘It was said such’, and ‘he said such’, i.e., useless discussions and arguments), and wastage of the wealth, and abundant questioning’.
en.sarwar: 4. A number of our people have narrated from Sahl ibn Ziyad from Ali ibn Asbat from certain persons of our people from ‘Amr ibn abu al-Miqdam who has said the following: “Abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said, ‘
One’s trusting a treacherous person and wasting assets is a worthless act.’”
